name: Dukanes
description: The Dukanes were an Italian-American street gang from Williamsburg, Brooklyn, originating out of the Jackson Street settlement house in the 1950s. Their rivals included the Saints, El Quintos, Phantom Lords, Halsey Bops, and the Chaplains. The gang is believed to be a predecessor to the Jackson Gents, with at least one member photographed wearing a Dukanes jacket before the group adopted that later name.
